title: Natura Hair Removal & Skin Care - Dadeland Mall
ownerDescription:
NATURA Hair Removal & Skin Care at Dadeland Mall the only Brazilian-owned spa in Kendall offering every type of hair removal under one roof: waxing, Sugaring Melt®️, laser with the Candela GentleMax Pro, and electrolysis for teens, women, and men. Our proprietary 3-Step Brazilian Waxing Method, perfected over 16+ years, delivers smoother results with less discomfort. Skincare from natural to medical-grade:

HydraFacial, microneedling, chemical peels, dermaplaning, vajacial, laser skin tightening, and organic facials. All products are natural, vegan, and hypoallergenic. Conveniently inside Dadeland Mall. Serving Kendall, Pinecrest, and Palmetto Bay.

ownerUpdates.text:
Summer in Miami means you are always on. Beach, brunch, rooftop. Every detail has to be right.

At Natura Dadeland Mall, a nose or chin wax for just $12 gives you that polished, clean look in minutes. And 10% off your legs wax means silky, smooth legs all season without the daily razor routine.

Stop by between your shopping. Leave summer-ready. ✨

You are already at Dadeland. You might as well leave with the best skin of your summer.

At Natura Dadeland Mall, our Deluxe and Platinum HydraFacials are $100 OFF in July. One session is all it takes to deeply cleanse, extract clogged pores, and flood your skin with hydrating serums tailored to your skin type.

The results are immediate, the glow is undeniable, and the spot availability is limited. ✨

Try the Brazilian technique that only Natura has. $39 for new clients.

At Natura Dadeland Mall, we do waxing the Brazilian way. Our exclusive Brazilian Sugaring Melt uses a natural formula of sugar, lemon juice, and water, combined with our unique 3-Step Method created by Natura founder Rafaela Chagas.

This technique is only available at Natura and it delivers results that razors and generic waxing simply cannot match.

New clients: first Brazilian Sugaring Melt for just $39. Smooth, soft, and irritation-free skin awaits.

reviews.name: Mariam Ibanez
reviews.text: Natura Spa is just the best, it's so clean and aesthetic, I love it. my spa specialists have been Desiree and Claudia, both have made me laugh a lot which makes any treatment enjoyable, and both are very professional as well as careful and gentle throughout the entire process. Mirielle in the front desk was also very helpful and kind. I would recommend the laser treatment to everyone it is safe and very effective. The rescue oil is also a must try, smells so good!
reviews.textTranslated: Natura Spa memang yang terbaik, sangat bersih dan estetik, saya sangat menyukainya. Spesialis spa saya adalah Desiree dan Claudia, keduanya selalu membuat saya tertawa sehingga setiap perawatan menjadi menyenangkan, dan keduanya sangat profesional serta teliti dan lembut selama seluruh proses. Minyak penyelamatnya juga wajib dicoba, baunya sangat enak!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hey Mariam, we are so glad to hear you enjoyed your service with us today! Enjoying your treatment is always our goal! We can't wait to see you again!

reviews.name: Gladys Nunez
reviews.text:
​I have been coming here for both Brazilian and underarm waxes, and the entire experience is consistently top-notch. From the moment you walk in, the reception is warm, welcoming, and impeccably organized. Check-in is a breeze, and you never have to wait around.
​The level of professionalism from the staff instantly puts you at ease. Waxing—especially a Brazilian—can sometimes feel intimidating, but they make the process so quick, comfortable, and smooth that it completely redefines the experience. Everything is handled with the utmost care, hygiene, and efficiency.
​If you want a salon where the team is talented, the environment is pristine, and the whole appointment goes off without a hitch, this is the place to go. I cannot recommend them enough!
reviews.textTranslated:
Saya sudah sering datang ke sini untuk waxing Brazilian dan ketiak, dan seluruh pengalaman selalu luar biasa. Sejak Anda masuk, resepsionisnya ramah, hangat, dan terorganisir dengan sempurna. Proses check-in sangat mudah, dan Anda tidak perlu menunggu lama.
Tingkat profesionalisme dari staf langsung membuat Anda merasa nyaman. Waxing—terutama Brazilian—kadang-kadang terasa menakutkan, tetapi mereka membuat prosesnya begitu cepat, nyaman, dan lancar sehingga benar-benar mengubah pengalaman tersebut. Semuanya ditangani dengan sangat hati-hati, higienis, dan efisien.
Jika Anda menginginkan salon dengan tim yang berbakat, lingkungan yang bersih, dan seluruh janji temu berjalan lancar, inilah tempatnya. Saya sangat merekomendasikan mereka!

reviews.name: Janelli Munoz
reviews.text:
Wonderful experience with Vivian and the laser treatment on the underarms. Painless and she was kind and efficient. Also, Lexa and Bianca are both very kind and patiently explain the treatments and after care.

I went again for a laser treatment on the underarms with Claudia and a European facial with Lexa. Lexa was super and I really enjoyed the painless and effective facial that left my face looking fresh and rejuvenated. Claudia was also great and kind. She even lowered the intensity if it bothered me. I will definitely return. Thank you. ☺️

I came for a second facial with Marcela and she was amazing as well. She cleaned my face with nicely and did some manual extractions and used the machine to do so, too. She applied two different masks, one of bamboo and the other of cinnamon enzyme. She hydrated my face with a third mask and applied some toner, moisturizer and sunscreen at the end of the session. She even recommended some Doctor D. Schwab products and mentioned I should wash my face morning and night, apply a toner, moisturizer and sunscreen everyday.
reviews.textTranslated:
Pengalaman yang luar biasa dengan Vivian dan perawatan laser di ketiak. Tanpa rasa sakit dan dia ramah serta efisien. Selain itu, Lexa dan Bianca juga sangat ramah dan dengan sabar menjelaskan perawatan dan perawatan setelahnya.

Saya kembali lagi untuk perawatan laser di ketiak dengan Claudia dan perawatan wajah ala Eropa dengan Lexa. Lexa sangat hebat dan saya sangat menikmati perawatan wajah yang tanpa rasa sakit dan efektif yang membuat wajah saya terlihat segar dan awet muda. Claudia juga hebat dan ramah. Dia bahkan menurunkan intensitasnya jika itu mengganggu saya. Saya pasti akan kembali. Terima kasih. ☺️

Saya datang untuk perawatan wajah kedua dengan Marcela dan dia juga luar biasa. Dia membersihkan wajah saya dengan baik dan melakukan beberapa ekstraksi manual dan juga menggunakan mesin untuk melakukannya. Dia mengaplikasikan dua masker berbeda, satu dari bambu dan yang lainnya dari enzim kayu manis. Dia menghidrasi wajah saya dengan masker ketiga dan mengaplikasikan toner, pelembap, dan tabir surya di akhir sesi. Dia bahkan merekomendasikan beberapa produk Doctor D. Schwab dan menyebutkan bahwa saya harus mencuci muka pagi dan malam, serta menggunakan toner, pelembap, dan tabir surya setiap hari.
